notes: Final fix wave: `service NAME verb` of init-system-helpers (Debian/Ubuntu) and initscripts-service (AlmaLinux 9) on systemd containers (docker run -d --privileged --cgroupns=host -v /sys/fs/cgroup:/sys/fs/cgroup:rw <image> /sbin/init), docker exec [-u tester] <c> bash -c '<cmd>', stdout, stderr and rc apart, no tty. tester: a user of useradd -m, no polkit agent. Final fix wave: systemctl verbs on an unknown unit and as a user without polkit (systemd containers as service.json), and top -v / -h / -V / --version / --help / -x of procps 4 (docker run --rm <image>, apt-get install procps, no tty, TERM unset). Stop statuses: systemctl stop UNIT; systemctl status UNIT --no-pager -n 0 after installing the packages (rsyslog of debian:12 / ubuntu:24.04 is started again by syslog.socket). logrotate: the BaseOS repositories of the AlmaLinux vault per minor release.
